map.喝水提醒计划计算器 使用指南: Water-Intake Reminder Plan Calculator - User Guide
map.输入体重、运动强度与当日气温，结合特殊情况估算每日建议饮水量并生成喝水时间表，辅: Enter weight, exercise intensity and daily temperature, combined with special conditions, to estimate daily recommended water intake and generate a drinking schedule, aiding daily hydration management.
map.饮水目标 = 体重×30ml + 运动增量 + 高温增量 + 特殊增量: Water target = weight*30 mL + exercise increment + high-temperature increment + special increment
map.基础量按 30ml/kg（成人常见 30–35ml/kg 区间取下限）；运动增量: Base amount by 30 mL/kg (adults commonly 30-35 mL/kg, take the lower bound); exercise increment by intensity 0/200/500/800 mL; temperature >=25 C add 250 mL, >=30 C add 400 mL; pregnancy add 300 mL, lactation add 700 mL. The total is then allocated by the ten slots from 07:00 to 22:00 to give a segmented drinking plan.
map.按体重估每日饮水。: Estimate daily water intake by weight.
map.夏季户外作业前按体重与气温估算每日饮水与分段计划，预防脱水。: Before summer outdoor work, estimate daily water intake and a segmented plan by weight and temperature to prevent dehydration.
map.：体重 70 kg × 35 mL ≈ 2.45 L/日（含食物水分约 30–4: : weight 70 kg * 35 mL ~ 2.45 L/day (including food water about 30-40 mL/kg).
map.汤羹和水果算水量吗？: Do soups and fruits count as water intake?
map.通常食物可贡献约两成水分，页面按纯饮水目标估算，实际可把汤羹水果折算后略减饮水量: Food usually contributes about 20% of water; the page estimates by pure-drinking target, in practice you can convert soups/fruits and slightly reduce intake.
